detail.title: Compass generator: weighted-domain W114 attack
detail.description:
Use the Compass "Next Domain -> Return" operation as an exact algebraic generator.

NEW EXACT FRAME:
W114 alpha=(1,7,78,79,86,91)\_114 is the lift of the weighted character
(1,7,13,79,43,91)
on the weighted Fermat fourfold with coordinate exponents
(114,114,19,114,57,114)
and weights (1,1,6,1,2,1).

The finite power map is
(x0:x1:x2:x3:x4:x5) -> (x0:x1:x2^6:x3:x4^2:x5)
in the appropriate weighted direction. Martelotte–Miranda–Movasati–Villaflor Proposition 3.2 proves that Hodge and algebraic character status are equivalent under lift, with explicit cycle pullback/pushforward.

CURRENT COMPUTATIONAL FINDING:
Using the public Aoki-Shioda generator definitions at degrees 114, 228, 342, and 456, an exact MILP search over six-entry grade-3 representatives (generator coefficients bounded by ±2) minimized the weighted coordinate-exponent complexity at the same value 532, always with effective exponent multiset
{114,114,114,114,57,19}.
This is bounded computational evidence, not a global theorem, but it says simple degree lifting alone is not reducing the four rigid coordinates.

LIFTED GAP FRAME:
The 2026 length-reduction table gives the q=57 exceptional representative
(23,41,64,66,71,77)\_114
of length 6.
An exact degree-114 integer relation was found between W114 alpha and this sextuple using only the paper's lineal/standard generators; the minimum ±1-support relation uses 25 generators in the tested generator set.

Next:

* preserve certificate for the 25-term relation;
* search weighted Fermat cycle families in the exact alternate frame;
* optimize for geometric simplicity, not merely tuple length;
* return every candidate via the finite map before promotion.
